title: Helicopter Extraction Operations

nodes.text: On-scene EMT or Medical Incident IC determines/requests medical extraction and coordinates order through IMT or local dispatch

evidence.source_text: On-scene EMT or Medical Incident IC determines/requests that medical extraction is required and coordinates the order through the Incident Management Team (IMT) or local dispatch.

nodes.text: Use the Medical Incident Report (page 120). Include patient weight and name of on-scene radio contact

evidence.source_text: Use the Medical Incident Report (page 120). Include the patient weight and name of on-scene radio contact.

nodes.text: Establish communications with incoming aircrew. Provide information: known hazards, terrain, wind speed/direction, patient update

evidence.source_text: Establish communications with incoming aircrew. Provide the following information: known hazards, terrain, wind speed/direction, patient update.

nodes.text: Choose extraction site away from fireline or black edge

evidence.source_text: Choose extraction site away from fireline or black edge.

nodes.text: Ensure area is clear of non-essential items and personnel. Follow aircrew directions

evidence.source_text: Ensure the area is clear of non-essential items and personnel. Follow the directions of the aircrew.

nodes.text: Consider rotor wash effects on overhead hazards and blowing dust/debris creating brown out conditions

evidence.source_text: Rotor wash may affect overhead hazards and blowing dust/debris can create brown out conditions.

nodes.text: Utilize aerial supervision for coordinating aviation medevac missions

evidence.source_text: Aerial Supervision is valuable for coordinating aviation medevac missions.

nodes.text: Can the helicopter be used safely?

evidence.source_text: The aircrew will make the final assessment regarding the safety of the mission.

nodes.text: Have contingency plan if helicopter cannot be used

evidence.source_text: Always have a contingency plan in case a helicopter cannot be used.

nodes.text: Follow basic fireline and aviation safety procedures regardless of emergency

evidence.source_text: Regardless of the emergency, follow basic fireline and aviation safety procedures.

nodes.text: Rescue Hoist: A cable winching device mounted to the helicopter that is capable of lowering/raising persons attached to the cable

evidence.source_text: Rescue Hoist: A cable winching device mounted to the helicopter that is capable of lowering/raising persons attached to the cable.

nodes.text: Short-Haul: To transport one or more persons suspended on a fixed line beneath a helicopter to a safe landing area

evidence.source_text: Short-Haul: To transport one or more persons suspended on a fixed line beneath a helicopter. The intent is to transport persons a short distance (short-haul), normally from a limited or inaccessible location to a safe landing area.
